job.job_description:
Job Role: Responsible AI (RAI) Engineer



Embed Responsible AI principles such as fairness, accountability, transparency, privacy, and safety into AI solutions.
Design and implement bias detection, bias mitigation, explainability, and model governance frameworks.
Build and enforce guardrails for LLM and GenAI systems.
Conduct AI risk assessments before production deployment.
Ensure compliance with AI governance policies, regulations, and industry standards.
Monitor AI systems for hallucinations, harmful outputs, bias, drift, data leakage, and misuse.
Support AI audits, reviews, and governance board evaluations.
Collaborate with Legal, Compliance, Security, Risk, Data Science, and Engineering teams.
Define and implement AI monitoring, logging, and audit mechanisms.



Required Skills

Generative AI, LLMs, Machine Learning, AI Ethics
Responsible AI principles (Fairness, Transparency, Accountability, Explainability)
AI Governance, Risk Management, Compliance
AI Safety and Guardrails
Python Programming
AI Monitoring and Observability
Security, Privacy, and Data Protection
Model Validation and Risk Assessment



Preferred Skills

Experience with Responsible AI frameworks and governance tools.
Knowledge of global AI regulations and compliance requirements.
Experience implementing content moderation and LLM safety controls.
Familiarity with AI audit processes and enterprise governance models.



Experience

6 to 10 years of overall experience in Software, Data, AI, or ML Engineering.
2 to 4+ years in AI Governance, Responsible AI, AI Security, Risk, Ethics, or Compliance-focused roles.
Hands-on experience with GenAI/LLM-based applications is highly desirable.
